summary.text: Jerry Lonergan is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 71 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Steven Howe.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a research economist and listed quality jobs and tax fairness among his key messages.

paragraphs.text: Jerry Lonergan earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Missouri-Kansas City in 1990 and attended the University of Kansas for graduate study, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as researcher.
In his survey responses he said he worked as a construction laborer for six years while putting himself through college.

He said he later worked as a research economist with a membership organization for chief executives of large Kansas City-area employers, owned a research and consulting practice for six years, and ran a research consortium for Kansas electric utilities that measured and publicly provided wind resource data.
He said he has been married for 47 years and has two children and five grandchildren.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for District 71 on August 4, 2026.
Lonergan listed quality jobs, tax fairness and listening to Kansans as his key campaign messages.
He named new businesses and good jobs, and making Kansas attractive for young people to stay and work, as his policy interests.
